chunks: And from Nawf al-Bakali, who said: I saw the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) one night, having come out from his bed, and he looked at the stars, then he said to me: 'O Nawf, are you sleeping or awake?' I said: 'Rather, I am awake,' then he said:
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali do when he was awake at night according to Nawf al-Bakali?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha captures Imam Ali’s (AS) habit of nocturnal vigil (Qiyam al-Layl), where he observed the celestial bodies as signs of divine power and order. It underscores the Shia emphasis on combining intellectual reflection on creation with spiritual devotion, illustrating the Imam’s role as a guide who uses natural phenomena to awaken the soul to higher truths.
